info.syllabusEnglish: Service Quality Management in Hospitality Industry
info.description:
Chapter 1: 
Introduction to Services

Chapter 2: Service Quality Management

Chapter 3: Customer Expectations of Service 

Chapter 4: 
Customer Perceptions of Service 

Chapter 5:  Culture and people

Chapter 6: Communication

Chapter 7:  Measuring and Managing Service Delivery

Chapter 8: 
Service and Technology
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Understand thoroughly basic knowledge about hospitality service quality management: foundation of service quality, and managing service promises. Understand thoroughly and be able to implement delivering and performing service.
Be able to consider and analyze the customer requirement. Provide criteria for assessing the effectiveness of the organization

Be able to self-analyze and identify the requirements of service quality in hospitality to show the ability to serve and meet the requirements of professionalism brings harmony. Heart to customer; Know how to bring you the perfect service.
Be able to perform professional ethics and attitude in service environment. Students are trained to practice ethical value.
